mapper.sql: SELECT reporting_year || '-' || LPAD(period_value::text, 2, '0') AS period, total_score, e_score, s_score, g_score, CASE WHEN total_score >= 90 THEN 'S' WHEN total_score >= 85 THEN 'A+' WHEN total_score >= 80 THEN 'A' WHEN total_score >= 75 THEN 'B+' WHEN total_score >= 65 THEN 'B' WHEN total_score >= 50 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS grade, calculated_at, period_value FROM esg_scores WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND reporting_year = #{year} AND reporting_period = 'MONTHLY'
mapper.select: WITH current_values AS ( SELECT i.category::text AS category, i.indicator_code, i.title, i.unit, CASE WHEN i.indicator_code IN ('IND_E_ELEC', 'IND_E_SCOPE2') THEN SUM(m.numerical_value) ELSE AVG(m.numerical_value) END AS value FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 6, 2)::INT AND m.status = 'APPROVED' AND m.facility_id = #{facilityId} GROUP BY i.category, i.indicator_code, i.title, i.unit ), previous_period AS ( SELECT MAX(m2.reporting_year * 100 + m2.period_value) AS period_key FROM esg_metric_data m2 WHERE m2.company_id = #{companyId} AND m2.status = 'APPROVED' AND (m2.reporting_year * 100 + m2.period_value) < (SUBSTRING(#{period}, 1, 4)::INT * 100 + SUBSTRING(#{period}, 6, 2)::INT) AND m2.facility_id = #{facilityId} ), previous_values AS ( SELECT i.indicator_code, CASE WHEN i.indicator_code IN ('IND_E_ELEC', 'IND_E_SCOPE2') THEN SUM(m.numerical_value) ELSE AVG(m.numerical_value) END AS previous_value FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND (m.reporting_year * 100 + m.period_value) = (SELECT period_key FROM previous_period) AND m.status = 'APPROVED' AND m.facility_id = #{facilityId} GROUP BY i.indicator_code ) SELECT c.category, c.indicator_code, c.title, c.unit, c.value, p.previous_value FROM current_values c LEFT JOIN previous_values p ON p.indicator_code = c.indicator_code ORDER BY CASE c.category WHEN 'ENVIRONMENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'SOCIAL' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.indicator_code

SELECT f.id AS facility_id, f.facility_name, f.facility_type, f.address, ST_Y(f.facility_center::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(f.facility_center::geometry) AS longitude, MAX(CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' THEN m.numerical_value END) AS electricity_usage_kwh, MAX(CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' THEN m.numerical_value END) AS scope2_tco2eq, MAX(CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_S_INJURY_RATE' THEN m.numerical_value END) AS injury_rate, MAX(CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_S_SAFETY_EDU' THEN m.numerical_value END) AS training_completion_rate, MAX(CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_S_RISK_ACTION' THEN m.numerical_value END) AS hazard_action_rate, MAX(CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_S_TURNOVER' THEN m.numerical_value END) AS turnover_rate FROM company_facilities f LEFT JOIN esg_metric_data m ON m.facility_id = f.id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 6, 2)::INT AND m.status = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE f.company_id = #{companyId} AND f.id = #{facilityId} GROUP BY f.id, f.facility_name, f.facility_type, f.address, f.facility_center ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.facility_type = 'HQ' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, f.facility_name
